description: Compound beat: location, time, and inventory all change in one turn.
user_msg: I take the rope and go to the watchtower.
turn: At 06:40 she reaches the watchtower and slings the coil of rope over one shoulder.
notes: A scene transition (location change) is a BTS checkpoint trigger; the turn also carries an Env time reading and a '+item' gain. Multiple keys stay separate pipe entries. 'go to' resolves to travel (travel outranks task in the classifier).
